dossier.headline: Aries Agro locks at upper circuit after Q2 revenue jumps 45%
dossier.summary: Aries Agro's September-quarter revenue rose 45% to ₹296 crore. The stock locked at its 5% upper circuit at ₹526.75 on Monday.
why_it_matters: A results-driven move in a small agrochemical name on a day when smaller stocks broadly fell
watch: Whether buying continues once the circuit lifts
questions: How did profit and margins move in the quarter?
